This [[Gender/Legends|male]] ''' Ychthytonian well-wisher''' was among a group of [[Senator/Legends|senator's]] aides, well-wishers present in the anteroom of [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] shortly after she took on the duties of [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] following [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo's]] resignation in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] hid from a Kloperian guard behind the [[Ychthytonian]].
